mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals an economy in recovery phase where monetary policy remains accommodative, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as stimulus measures support equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC over 2020-2023 is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% in 60% of cases but SPX returns are negative in > 50% of those cases, or the Rank IC over 2020-2023 is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market recovery (HOUST > 500 thousand units) signals increased consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as residential investment boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: HOUST > 500 in 70% of cases but SPX returns are negative in > 40% of those cases, or the Rank IC over 2020-2023 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) and rising industrial production (INDPRO > 99.5) signals a synchronized monetary and supply-side recovery, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS<=0.25% AND INDPRO>99.5) occurs in 50% of cases but SPX returns are negative in > 40% of those cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime (UNRATE > 9.0% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), rising retail sales (RSAFS > 350,000 million) signals strengthening consumer demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-recession recovery regime, RSAFS > 350000 occurs in 60% of cases but SPX returns are negative in > 40% of those cases, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls > 0.5pp in 1 month in 50% of cases but SPX returns are negative in > 40% of those cases, or the Rank IC over 2020-2023 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (2017=100) signals a robust manufacturing sector that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 in 60% of cases but SPX returns are negative in > 40% of those cases, or the Rank IC over 2020-2023 is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% in 70% of cases but SPX returns are negative in > 40% of those cases over 60-day horizon, or the Rank IC over 2020-2023 is below 0.02.
